BasicProcessConfig.description:
Legacy process config retained for backward compatibility.
AnnData path management now belongs in GeneralConfig.

input_adata_path.description: Configuration value for input adata path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Configuration value for output adata path.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

batch_correction_obs.description: Name of the adata.obs column that identifies technical batches to remove from the biological latent space. Values are converted to strings and encoded as consecutive integers; the column must exist and should describe technical rather than biological variation.
batch_correction_obs.title: Batch Correction Obs

n_for_pca.description: Deprecated compatibility setting retained for older configurations. The current BioBatchNet stage does not run PCA and does not use this value.
n_for_pca.title: N For Pca

leiden_resolutions_list.description: Leiden resolutions calculated from the neighbour graph of X_biobatchnet when both biobatchnet_run_postprocess and biobatchnet_run_leiden are enabled. Each result is stored in adata.obs as leiden_<resolution>.
leiden_resolutions_list.title: Leiden Resolutions List

umap_min_dist.description: Scanpy UMAP min_dist used when post-processing the biological BioBatchNet embedding; smaller values produce more compact local groupings but do not change model training.
umap_min_dist.title: Umap Min Dist

biobatchnet_params.description: BioBatchNet training parameters passed to the pinned BioBatchNet API. The mapping controls data_type, latent_dim, epochs, device, whether to use adata.raw, and extra_params such as the six legacy loss_weights. By default the model consumes adata.X and automatically uses CUDA when available.
biobatchnet_params.title: Biobatchnet Params

biobatchnet_scan_parameter_sets.description: Optional list of BioBatchNet parameter overrides to train as separate scan runs. A set may include a name used only as its output label; other keys override the base biobatchnet_params. Supplying extra_params.loss_weights replaces the complete base loss-weight mapping, so include all six required legacy keys.
biobatchnet_scan_parameter_sets.title: Biobatchnet Scan Parameter Sets

biobatchnet_scan_include_base.description: Also run the unmodified biobatchnet_params configuration when parameter sets are scanned. The base run writes output_adata_path; named scan runs write sibling files.
biobatchnet_scan_include_base.title: Biobatchnet Scan Include Base

biobatchnet_run_postprocess.description: Compute a Scanpy neighbour graph and UMAP from X_biobatchnet after training, and optionally Leiden clusters. Disable to retain only the learned embeddings and metadata.
biobatchnet_run_postprocess.title: Biobatchnet Run Postprocess

biobatchnet_run_leiden.description: Run Leiden clustering at leiden_resolutions_list during BioBatchNet post-processing. This has no effect when biobatchnet_run_postprocess is disabled.
biobatchnet_run_leiden.title: Biobatchnet Run Leiden

n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbours used to build the Scanpy graph from X_biobatchnet. When unset, Scanpy's default is used; this affects UMAP and Leiden but not BioBatchNet training.
n_neighbors.title: N Neighbors

biobatchnet_data_type.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.data_type. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_data_type.title: Biobatchnet Data Type

biobatchnet_latent_dim.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.latent_dim. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_latent_dim.title: Biobatchnet Latent Dim

biobatchnet_epochs.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.epochs. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_epochs.title: Biobatchnet Epochs

biobatchnet_device.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.device. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_device.title: Biobatchnet Device

biobatchnet_kwargs.description: Deprecated flat alias that replaces biobatchnet_params.extra_params. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_kwargs.title: Biobatchnet Kwargs

biobatchnet_use_raw.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.use_raw. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_use_raw.title: Biobatchnet Use Raw

BasicProcessConfig.title: BasicProcessConfig

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input path for batch integration; use null to read general.anndata_path through the pipeline's normal stage-state checks.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Optional destination for the integrated AnnData; use null to update general.anndata_path with the new PCA, integration, neighbour, UMAP, Leiden, and provenance entries.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

batch_correction_obs.description: AnnData obs column defining the technical batches to balance or correct. It is required for harmony, bbknn, and both, and should not be a biological variable confounded with the comparison of interest.
batch_correction_obs.title: Batch Correction Obs

integration_method.description: Integration strategy: harmony corrects PCA coordinates; bbknn constructs a batch-balanced neighbour graph from uncorrected PCA; both applies Harmony then BBKNN; none uses ordinary Scanpy neighbours without batch correction.
integration_method.title: Integration Method

batch_correction_method.description: Deprecated alias for integration_method retained for older YAML files. When set, this value overrides integration_method; new configurations should leave it null.
batch_correction_method.title: Batch Correction Method

n_for_pca.description: Number of principal components recomputed from the current AnnData matrix and used for integration. Null requests markers minus one, clipped to the valid range set by cell and marker counts.
n_for_pca.title: N For Pca

leiden_resolutions_list.description: Leiden resolution values evaluated on the final neighbour graph; each value creates adata.obs['leiden_<resolution>'], with larger values generally producing more clusters.
leiden_resolutions_list.title: Leiden Resolutions List

umap_min_dist.description: UMAP minimum-distance parameter used after integration; lower values permit tighter visual clusters, while higher values spread local neighbourhoods more broadly. It does not change the neighbour graph.
umap_min_dist.title: Umap Min Dist

run_leiden.description: Run Leiden clustering for every configured resolution after constructing the final graph; disable to retain integration and UMAP without writing new Leiden labels.
run_leiden.title: Run Leiden

n_neighbors.description: Target neighbourhood size. Harmony and none pass it to Scanpy neighbours; BBKNN converts it to ceil(n_neighbors / number_of_batches) neighbours per batch unless bbknn_params sets neighbors_within_batch. Null uses each library's default.
n_neighbors.title: N Neighbors

pca_key.description: AnnData obsm key read as the PCA input. Keep X_pca for normal runs because the stage recomputes PCA with Scanpy and Scanpy writes the result to that key.
pca_key.title: Pca Key

harmony_key.description: AnnData obsm key that receives Harmony-corrected principal-component coordinates in harmony or both mode; marker values in adata.X are not corrected.
harmony_key.title: Harmony Key

representation_key.description: Canonical AnnData obsm key used for downstream graph construction: it stores copied PCA coordinates for bbknn or none, and corrected coordinates for harmony or both.
representation_key.title: Representation Key

qc_output_subdir.description: Subdirectory below the active QC/report location for batch-coloured and Leiden UMAP figures. It does not affect reusable AnnData output paths.
qc_output_subdir.title: Qc Output Subdir

harmony_params.description: Keyword arguments passed directly to harmonypy.run_harmony after null-like values are removed. Defaults allow 30 Harmony rounds, log progress, and seed stochastic steps with 0; advanced options include theta, sigma, lamb, and convergence settings.
harmony_params.title: Harmony Params

bbknn_params.description: Keyword arguments passed to scanpy.external.pp.bbknn after null-like values are removed. The stage supplies use_rep and n_pcs when absent; common advanced options include neighbors_within_batch, trim, metric, and approximate-neighbour settings.
bbknn_params.title: Bbknn Params

input_adata_path.description: AnnData file containing the per-cell expression matrix and batch annotation. When unset, the stage reads general.anndata_path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Destination for the AnnData with BioBatchNet embeddings and optional Scanpy results. When unset, general.anndata_path is updated in place.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

batch_correction_obs.description: Name of the adata.obs column that identifies technical batches to remove from the biological latent space. Values are converted to strings and encoded as consecutive integers; the column must exist and should describe technical rather than biological variation.
batch_correction_obs.title: Batch Correction Obs

n_for_pca.description: Deprecated compatibility setting retained for older configurations. The current BioBatchNet stage does not run PCA and does not use this value.
n_for_pca.title: N For Pca

leiden_resolutions_list.description: Leiden resolutions calculated from the neighbour graph of X_biobatchnet when both biobatchnet_run_postprocess and biobatchnet_run_leiden are enabled. Each result is stored in adata.obs as leiden_<resolution>.
leiden_resolutions_list.title: Leiden Resolutions List

umap_min_dist.description: Scanpy UMAP min_dist used when post-processing the biological BioBatchNet embedding; smaller values produce more compact local groupings but do not change model training.
umap_min_dist.title: Umap Min Dist

biobatchnet_params.description: BioBatchNet training parameters passed to the pinned BioBatchNet API. The mapping controls data_type, latent_dim, epochs, device, whether to use adata.raw, and extra_params such as the six legacy loss_weights. By default the model consumes adata.X and automatically uses CUDA when available.
biobatchnet_params.title: Biobatchnet Params

biobatchnet_scan_parameter_sets.description: Optional list of BioBatchNet parameter overrides to train as separate scan runs. A set may include a name used only as its output label; other keys override the base biobatchnet_params. Supplying extra_params.loss_weights replaces the complete base loss-weight mapping, so include all six required legacy keys.
biobatchnet_scan_parameter_sets.title: Biobatchnet Scan Parameter Sets

biobatchnet_scan_include_base.description: Also run the unmodified biobatchnet_params configuration when parameter sets are scanned. The base run writes output_adata_path; named scan runs write sibling files.
biobatchnet_scan_include_base.title: Biobatchnet Scan Include Base

biobatchnet_run_postprocess.description: Compute a Scanpy neighbour graph and UMAP from X_biobatchnet after training, and optionally Leiden clusters. Disable to retain only the learned embeddings and metadata.
biobatchnet_run_postprocess.title: Biobatchnet Run Postprocess

biobatchnet_run_leiden.description: Run Leiden clustering at leiden_resolutions_list during BioBatchNet post-processing. This has no effect when biobatchnet_run_postprocess is disabled.
biobatchnet_run_leiden.title: Biobatchnet Run Leiden

n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbours used to build the Scanpy graph from X_biobatchnet. When unset, Scanpy's default is used; this affects UMAP and Leiden but not BioBatchNet training.
n_neighbors.title: N Neighbors

biobatchnet_data_type.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.data_type. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_data_type.title: Biobatchnet Data Type

biobatchnet_latent_dim.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.latent_dim. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_latent_dim.title: Biobatchnet Latent Dim

biobatchnet_epochs.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.epochs. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_epochs.title: Biobatchnet Epochs

biobatchnet_device.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.device. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_device.title: Biobatchnet Device

biobatchnet_kwargs.description: Deprecated flat alias that replaces biobatchnet_params.extra_params. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_kwargs.title: Biobatchnet Kwargs

biobatchnet_use_raw.description: Deprecated flat alias for biobatchnet_params.use_raw. Prefer the nested parameter mapping.
biobatchnet_use_raw.title: Biobatchnet Use Raw

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input override; when unset, the stage reads general.anndata_path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData output override; when unset, the stage updates general.anndata_path.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

qc_output_subdir.description: Subdirectory created under general.qc_folder for CellCharter tables and figures.
qc_output_subdir.title: Qc Output Subdir

use_rep.description: AnnData obsm representation aggregated in non-TRVAE mode; integration-family keys can fall back to another available pipeline embedding, and null selects a layer, an automatic reduced representation, or X.
use_rep.title: Use Rep

use_layer.description: AnnData layer used instead of X when no non-TRVAE use_rep is selected, or used as the TRVAE input when TRVAE mode is enabled.
use_layer.title: Use Layer

scale_by_sample.description: Z-score every input feature within each sample before TRVAE fitting or, in non-TRVAE mode, before neighbourhood aggregation.
scale_by_sample.title: Scale By Sample

scaled_rep_key.description: AnnData obsm key used to store sample-scaled features or a layer copied into a matrix suitable for aggregation.
scaled_rep_key.title: Scaled Rep Key

use_trvae.description: Train or load a TRVAE and aggregate its latent representation instead of using the existing non-TRVAE representation.
use_trvae.title: Use Trvae

trvae_latent_key.description: AnnData obsm key receiving the TRVAE latent coordinates used for neighbourhood aggregation.
trvae_latent_key.title: Trvae Latent Key

trvae_condition_key.description: AnnData obs column supplied to TRVAE as the batch or condition covariate to be integrated.
trvae_condition_key.title: Trvae Condition Key

trvae_use_sample_key_fallback.description: Allow the resolved ROI/sample column to serve as the TRVAE condition when trvae_condition_key is unavailable.
trvae_use_sample_key_fallback.title: Trvae Use Sample Key Fallback

trvae_constant_condition_label.description: Label assigned to every cell when no usable TRVAE condition column can be resolved.
trvae_constant_condition_label.title: Trvae Constant Condition Label

trvae_load_path.description: Optional directory containing a pretrained TRVAE model; a missing or invalid path causes a new model to be initialized.
trvae_load_path.title: Trvae Load Path

trvae_save_path.description: Directory for the reusable fitted TRVAE model; relative paths are resolved as project assets.
trvae_save_path.title: Trvae Save Path

trvae_map_location.description: Device location requested when loading a pretrained TRVAE model, such as gpu or cpu.
trvae_map_location.title: Trvae Map Location

trvae_train.description: Fit a newly initialized TRVAE or continue training a loaded model before computing latent coordinates.
trvae_train.title: Trvae Train

trvae_train_early_stopping.description: Enable TRVAE training early stopping when supported by the installed implementation.
trvae_train_early_stopping.title: Trvae Train Early Stopping

trvae_train_enable_progress_bar.description: Show the TRVAE training progress bar when supported by the installed implementation.
trvae_train_enable_progress_bar.title: Trvae Train Enable Progress Bar

trvae_train_max_epochs.description: Optional maximum TRVAE training epochs; null leaves the limit to the model's own default.
trvae_train_max_epochs.title: Trvae Train Max Epochs

trvae_hidden_layer_sizes.description: Widths of the TRVAE encoder and decoder hidden layers.
trvae_hidden_layer_sizes.title: Trvae Hidden Layer Sizes

trvae_latent_dim.description: Number of dimensions in the TRVAE latent representation.
trvae_latent_dim.title: Trvae Latent Dim

trvae_dr_rate.description: Dropout rate used by the TRVAE neural network.
trvae_dr_rate.title: Trvae Dr Rate

trvae_use_mmd.description: Use maximum mean discrepancy regularization to align the configured TRVAE conditions.
trvae_use_mmd.title: Trvae Use Mmd

trvae_mmd_on.description: TRVAE representation on which maximum mean discrepancy is applied, normally the latent space z.
trvae_mmd_on.title: Trvae Mmd On

trvae_mmd_boundary.description: Optional number of conditions across which TRVAE calculates maximum mean discrepancy; null applies it across all conditions.
trvae_mmd_boundary.title: Trvae Mmd Boundary

trvae_recon_loss.description: Reconstruction loss used to fit TRVAE; it should match the scale and distribution of the input features.
trvae_recon_loss.title: Trvae Recon Loss

trvae_beta.description: Weight applied to the TRVAE latent regularization term relative to reconstruction.
trvae_beta.title: Trvae Beta

trvae_use_bn.description: Enable batch normalization in the TRVAE network.
trvae_use_bn.title: Trvae Use Bn

trvae_use_ln.description: Enable layer normalization in the TRVAE network.
trvae_use_ln.title: Trvae Use Ln

delaunay.description: Construct each sample's spatial graph by Delaunay triangulation; disabling it uses Squidpy's generic-coordinate neighbour construction.
delaunay.title: Delaunay

remove_long_links.description: Remove unusually long spatial-graph edges after graph construction to reduce border-spanning artefacts.
remove_long_links.title: Remove Long Links

distance_percentile.description: Global percentile of positive edge distances above which links are removed when remove_long_links is enabled.
distance_percentile.title: Distance Percentile

n_layers.description: Maximum graph-hop layer to aggregate; an integer L includes the focal cell and separate summaries for hops 1 through L.
n_layers.title: N Layers

aggregations.description: Neighbour feature summary, such as mean or var; comma-separated values request multiple summaries for every nonzero hop layer.
aggregations.title: Aggregations

aggregated_rep_key.description: AnnData obsm key receiving the concatenated focal-cell and hop-specific neighbourhood features used for clustering.
aggregated_rep_key.title: Aggregated Rep Key

n_clusters.description: Fixed number of Gaussian-mixture spatial clusters to fit; this pipeline stage does not run CellCharter's automatic stability scan.
n_clusters.title: N Clusters

random_state.description: Random seed used to initialize the CellCharter Gaussian-mixture clustering model.
random_state.title: Random State

covariance_type.description: Gaussian-mixture covariance parameterization; full allows each cluster its own unrestricted covariance matrix.
covariance_type.title: Covariance Type

batch_size.description: Optional number of cells per Gaussian-mixture fitting batch; null lets CellCharter process the full matrix according to its default.
batch_size.title: Batch Size

trainer_accelerator.description: Lightning accelerator used for Gaussian-mixture fitting, for example auto, cpu, gpu, or cuda where supported.
trainer_accelerator.title: Trainer Accelerator

trainer_devices.description: Optional number of devices supplied to the CellCharter clustering trainer.
trainer_devices.title: Trainer Devices

trainer_max_epochs.description: Maximum training epochs for the Gaussian-mixture clustering model.
trainer_max_epochs.title: Trainer Max Epochs

cluster_key.description: AnnData obs column receiving categorical CellCharter niche labels; the numeric labels are identifiers without intrinsic order.
cluster_key.title: Cluster Key

repeat_analysis.description: Deprecated fallback for unset stage-specific repeat flags; null means each stage-specific flag defaults to recomputation.
repeat_analysis.title: Repeat Analysis

repeat_cluster_analysis.description: Recompute TRVAE, graph, aggregation, and clustering; false reuses cluster_key when it contains any non-null labels, while null defaults to recomputation.
repeat_cluster_analysis.title: Repeat Cluster Analysis

repeat_enrichment_analysis.description: Recompute cluster-by-cell-type enrichment; false reuses an existing compatible AnnData uns result, while null defaults to recomputation.
repeat_enrichment_analysis.title: Repeat Enrichment Analysis

repeat_nhood_enrichment_analysis.description: Recompute cluster neighbourhood enrichment; false reuses an existing AnnData uns result, while null defaults to recomputation.
repeat_nhood_enrichment_analysis.title: Repeat Nhood Enrichment Analysis

repeat_diff_nhood_enrichment_analysis.description: Recompute differential neighbourhood enrichment; false reuses an existing AnnData uns result, while null defaults to recomputation.
repeat_diff_nhood_enrichment_analysis.title: Repeat Diff Nhood Enrichment Analysis

repeat_shape_characterisation_analysis.description: Recompute connected components, boundaries, and shape metrics; false reuses complete existing component and uns outputs, while null defaults to recomputation.
repeat_shape_characterisation_analysis.title: Repeat Shape Characterisation Analysis

run_enrichment.description: Calculate enrichment of general.population_obs_primary cell types within each spatial cluster when that annotation is available.
run_enrichment.title: Run Enrichment

enrichment_with_pvalues.description: Estimate empirical P values for cluster-by-cell-type enrichment by permutation instead of reporting enrichment alone.
enrichment_with_pvalues.title: Enrichment With Pvalues

enrichment_n_perms.description: Number of permutations used when cluster-by-cell-type enrichment P values are enabled.
enrichment_n_perms.title: Enrichment N Perms

enrichment_plot_figsize.description: Width and height in inches for the CellCharter cluster-by-cell-type enrichment dot plot.
enrichment_plot_figsize.title: Enrichment Plot Figsize

enrichment_plot_dot_scale.description: Scale factor controlling marker sizes in the cluster-by-cell-type enrichment dot plot.
enrichment_plot_dot_scale.title: Enrichment Plot Dot Scale

enrichment_plot_show_pvalues.description: Display enrichment P-value information on the CellCharter enrichment plot when permutation P values exist.
enrichment_plot_show_pvalues.title: Enrichment Plot Show Pvalues

enrichment_plot_significant_only.description: Restrict the CellCharter enrichment plot to statistically significant results when P values are available.
enrichment_plot_significant_only.title: Enrichment Plot Significant Only

run_nhood_enrichment.description: Quantify whether pairs of spatial clusters share more or fewer graph edges than expected from their abundance and node degree.
run_nhood_enrichment.title: Run Nhood Enrichment

nhood_connectivity_key.description: Optional AnnData obsp connectivity key for neighbourhood enrichment; null uses CellCharter's default spatial connectivity matrix.
nhood_connectivity_key.title: Nhood Connectivity Key

nhood_log_fold_change.description: Report neighbourhood enrichment as log2 observed-over-expected instead of the default observed-minus-expected difference.
nhood_log_fold_change.title: Nhood Log Fold Change

nhood_only_inter.description: Exclude within-cluster edges so the analysis focuses on contacts between different spatial clusters.
nhood_only_inter.title: Nhood Only Inter

nhood_symmetric.description: Use symmetric edge-count enrichment; false uses directional edge proportions, so source-to-target and target-to-source values can differ.
nhood_symmetric.title: Nhood Symmetric

nhood_with_pvalues.description: Use permutations to estimate neighbourhood-enrichment P values; false uses the faster analytical expectation without P values.
nhood_with_pvalues.title: Nhood With Pvalues

nhood_n_perms.description: Number of permutations used when neighbourhood-enrichment P values are enabled.
nhood_n_perms.title: Nhood N Perms

nhood_n_jobs.description: Number of parallel workers used for permutation-based neighbourhood enrichment.
nhood_n_jobs.title: Nhood N Jobs

nhood_batch_size.description: Number of neighbourhood-enrichment permutations processed in each computational batch.
nhood_batch_size.title: Nhood Batch Size

nhood_observed_expected.description: Store the observed and expected edge matrices alongside the derived neighbourhood-enrichment matrix.
nhood_observed_expected.title: Nhood Observed Expected

save_nhood_enrichment_plot.description: Save CellCharter's neighbourhood-enrichment visualization in addition to exported matrices.
save_nhood_enrichment_plot.title: Save Nhood Enrichment Plot

nhood_plot_figsize.description: Width and height in inches for the CellCharter neighbourhood-enrichment plot.
nhood_plot_figsize.title: Nhood Plot Figsize

nhood_enrichment_significance.description: Optional P-value threshold used to mark or filter significance in the neighbourhood-enrichment plot.
nhood_enrichment_significance.title: Nhood Enrichment Significance

run_diff_nhood_enrichment.description: Compare spatial-cluster neighbourhood-enrichment matrices between biological or experimental conditions.
run_diff_nhood_enrichment.title: Run Diff Nhood Enrichment

diff_nhood_condition_key.description: AnnData obs column defining conditions; null falls back to general.groupby_obs and then common condition columns.
diff_nhood_condition_key.title: Diff Nhood Condition Key

diff_nhood_condition_groups.description: Optional ordered subset of condition levels to compare; null uses configured general group lists or all available levels.
diff_nhood_condition_groups.title: Diff Nhood Condition Groups

diff_nhood_connectivity_key.description: Optional AnnData obsp connectivity key for differential neighbourhood enrichment; null uses CellCharter's default spatial graph.
diff_nhood_connectivity_key.title: Diff Nhood Connectivity Key

diff_nhood_log_fold_change.description: Express each condition's neighbourhood enrichment as log2 observed-over-expected rather than observed-minus-expected before calculating contrasts.
diff_nhood_log_fold_change.title: Diff Nhood Log Fold Change

diff_nhood_only_inter.description: Exclude within-cluster edges from differential neighbourhood-enrichment comparisons.
diff_nhood_only_inter.title: Diff Nhood Only Inter

diff_nhood_symmetric.description: Use symmetric rather than directional neighbourhood enrichment within each condition.
diff_nhood_symmetric.title: Diff Nhood Symmetric

diff_nhood_with_pvalues.description: Estimate empirical P values by resampling condition labels at the sample/library level.
diff_nhood_with_pvalues.title: Diff Nhood With Pvalues

diff_nhood_library_key.description: AnnData obs column identifying independent samples or libraries for differential-enrichment permutations; null uses the resolved sample key.
diff_nhood_library_key.title: Diff Nhood Library Key

diff_nhood_n_perms.description: Number of sample-level condition permutations used for differential neighbourhood-enrichment P values.
diff_nhood_n_perms.title: Diff Nhood N Perms

diff_nhood_n_jobs.description: Optional number of parallel workers for differential neighbourhood-enrichment permutations.
diff_nhood_n_jobs.title: Diff Nhood N Jobs

diff_nhood_plot_ncols.description: Number of columns in the grid of condition-pair differential neighbourhood-enrichment plots.
diff_nhood_plot_ncols.title: Diff Nhood Plot Ncols

save_diff_nhood_enrichment_plot.description: Save CellCharter's differential neighbourhood-enrichment plot in addition to exported matrices.
save_diff_nhood_enrichment_plot.title: Save Diff Nhood Enrichment Plot

run_shape_characterisation.description: Identify connected components of spatial clusters, reconstruct their boundaries, and calculate configured component-shape metrics.
run_shape_characterisation.title: Run Shape Characterisation

shape_component_key.description: AnnData obs column receiving connected-component identifiers for spatially contiguous regions of a cluster.
shape_component_key.title: Shape Component Key

shape_component_cluster_key.description: AnnData obs labels whose connected components are characterized; null uses cluster_key.
shape_component_cluster_key.title: Shape Component Cluster Key

shape_connectivity_key.description: Optional AnnData obsp graph used to define connected components; null uses CellCharter's default spatial connectivity matrix.
shape_connectivity_key.title: Shape Connectivity Key

shape_min_cells.description: Minimum cells required for a same-cluster connected component to be retained for shape analysis.
shape_min_cells.title: Shape Min Cells

shape_min_hole_area_ratio.description: Minimum hole area relative to its component boundary area for the hole to be retained in the alpha-shape polygon.
shape_min_hole_area_ratio.title: Shape Min Hole Area Ratio

shape_alpha_start.description: Starting alpha value for CellCharter's iterative alpha-shape boundary reconstruction.
shape_alpha_start.title: Shape Alpha Start

shape_compute_linearity.description: Calculate component linearity, the dominant skeleton path length divided by total skeleton length.
shape_compute_linearity.title: Shape Compute Linearity

shape_linearity_key.description: Key used to store the per-component linearity metric in the CellCharter shape result.
shape_linearity_key.title: Shape Linearity Key

shape_linearity_height.description: Raster height used when converting component polygons to skeletons for the linearity calculation.
shape_linearity_height.title: Shape Linearity Height

shape_linearity_min_ratio.description: Minimum relative skeleton-branch length retained in the component linearity calculation.
shape_linearity_min_ratio.title: Shape Linearity Min Ratio

shape_compute_curl.description: Calculate component curl, a measure of how curved or twisted a region is relative to its major axis and fibre length.
shape_compute_curl.title: Shape Compute Curl

shape_curl_key.description: Key used to store the per-component curl metric in the CellCharter shape result.
shape_curl_key.title: Shape Curl Key

shape_plot_metrics.description: Plot computed shape metrics across configured condition or cluster groups when suitable metadata exists.
shape_plot_metrics.title: Shape Plot Metrics

shape_metrics_condition_key.description: AnnData obs condition used to group shape-metric plots; null falls back to the differential condition and then general.groupby_obs.
shape_metrics_condition_key.title: Shape Metrics Condition Key

shape_metrics_condition_groups.description: Optional ordered condition levels included in shape-metric plots.
shape_metrics_condition_groups.title: Shape Metrics Condition Groups

shape_metrics_cluster_key.description: AnnData obs cluster annotation used to stratify shape-metric plots; null uses shape_component_cluster_key or cluster_key.

CellVisionConfig.description: Configuration for single-cell image representation learning and clustering.

input_adata_path.advice: Leave unset to use the project's canonical AnnData object.
input_adata_path.description: Optional CellVision source AnnData path; defaults to general.anndata_path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

images_folder.advice: The folder must contain one subdirectory per ROI with one TIFF per marker.
images_folder.description: Optional ROI/channel image folder; defaults to general.denoised_images_folder.
images_folder.title: Images Folder

masks_folder.advice: Mask filenames must match ROI values and mask labels must match object_id_obs.
masks_folder.description: Optional labelled cell-mask folder; defaults to general.masks_folder.
masks_folder.title: Masks Folder

asset_folder.advice: Keep this outside general.outputs_folder; execution figures and tables are routed separately.
asset_folder.description: Canonical project-relative folder for reusable CellVision assets.
asset_folder.title: Asset Folder

roi_obs.advice: Values must match image subdirectory and mask filename stems exactly.
roi_obs.description: AnnData observation column containing ROI identifiers; defaults to general.roi_obs.
roi_obs.title: Roi Obs

object_id_obs.advice: The pair (ROI, object ID) must uniquely identify every selected source cell.
object_id_obs.description: AnnData observation column containing the integer label used in each ROI mask.
object_id_obs.title: Object Id Obs

population_obs.advice: Leave unset to analyse all cells without original-population comparison plots.
population_obs.description: Optional source population annotation used for filtering, comparison, and plots.
population_obs.title: Population Obs

populations.advice: Leave unset to retain every cell, even when population_obs is set for plotting.
populations.description: Optional population values to retain from population_obs.
populations.title: Populations

markers.advice: Each name must match the case-insensitive suffix immediately before a TIFF extension; both 165Ho_CD11c and CD11c can match a prefixed IMC filename. Leave unset for all channels.
markers.description: Optional ordered marker/channel names to include in cell images and VICReg training.
markers.title: Markers

image_size.advice: The 36 px default is intended to retain even relatively large IMC cells while limiting model size.
image_size.description: Height and width in pixels of each extracted single-cell image.
image_size.title: Image Size

extraction_threads.advice: Do not exceed the CPUs allocated by the CellVision SLURM wrapper.
extraction_threads.description: Worker processes used by scPortrait HDF5 cell extraction.
extraction_threads.title: Extraction Threads

mask_expand_px.advice: Keep zero to train strictly on the segmented cell boundary.
mask_expand_px.description: Optional labelled-mask expansion distance before extracting cell portraits.
mask_expand_px.title: Mask Expand Px

mask_gaussian_blur.advice: Keep false for 1 um/pixel IMC; enable only when softened mask edges are scientifically justified.
mask_gaussian_blur.description: Apply scPortrait's sigma-1 Gaussian blur to each extracted segmentation mask.
mask_gaussian_blur.title: Mask Gaussian Blur

normalization_dict_path.advice: Exact keys take priority; short Nimbus keys such as CD11c match a selected 165Ho_CD11c channel, while ambiguous suffixes fail. Relative paths resolve from the project root.
normalization_dict_path.description: Optional Nimbus-format normalization_dict.json containing one positive scale per selected marker or unambiguous marker suffix.
normalization_dict_path.title: Normalization Dict Path

normalization_quantile.advice: Matches the current Nimbus default and is used only when normalization_dict_path is unset.
normalization_quantile.description: Per-ROI in-mask quantile averaged to compute each channel normalization value.
normalization_quantile.title: Normalization Quantile

normalization_min_value.advice: Matches the current Nimbus default; supplied dictionary values are preserved after positive-value validation.
normalization_min_value.description: Minimum computed normalization value used to avoid scaling background noise.
normalization_min_value.title: Normalization Min Value

normalization_clip.advice: CellVision H5SC training images must remain within [0, 1].
normalization_clip.description: Lower and upper bounds applied after division by the channel normalization value.
normalization_clip.title: Normalization Clip

overwrite.advice: Enable only when inputs, selections, markers, or model settings have deliberately changed.
overwrite.description: Regenerate existing reusable CellVision assets instead of validating and reusing them.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

encoder_width.advice: Increase only when GPU memory and training-set size justify a larger encoder.
encoder_width.description: Base channel width of the compact residual VICReg encoder.
encoder_width.title: Encoder Width

embedding_dim.advice: This is the representation saved for every extracted source cell.
embedding_dim.description: Number of cell-level features emitted by the VICReg encoder.
embedding_dim.title: Embedding Dim

projector_dim.advice: The projector is used only for the self-supervised loss and is not exported as the cell embedding.
projector_dim.description: Hidden and output width of the VICReg training projector.
projector_dim.title: Projector Dim

epochs.advice: Inspect the training-loss report before increasing this value.
epochs.description: Number of self-supervised VICReg training epochs.
epochs.title: Epochs

batch_size.advice: VICReg variance/covariance estimates benefit from larger batches; reduce for GPU memory pressure.
batch_size.description: VICReg training and inference batch size.
batch_size.title: Batch Size

learning_rate.advice: The schedule uses linear warmup followed by cosine decay.
learning_rate.description: Initial AdamW learning rate for VICReg training.
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

weight_decay.advice: Keep small so image morphology is not over-regularized.
weight_decay.description: AdamW weight decay used during VICReg training.
weight_decay.title: Weight Decay

warmup_epochs.description: Number of linear learning-rate warmup epochs before cosine decay.
warmup_epochs.title: Warmup Epochs

num_workers.advice: Keep below the SLURM CPU allocation and reduce if the HDF5 filesystem is congested.
num_workers.description: PyTorch DataLoader worker processes for H5SC image reads.
num_workers.title: Num Workers

seed.advice: Keep fixed when comparing marker sets or populations.
seed.description: Random seed used for selection fingerprints, augmentations, training, and galleries.
seed.title: Seed

amp.advice: Disable when diagnosing numerical instability or using unsupported hardware.
amp.description: Use automatic mixed precision for CUDA VICReg training.
amp.title: Amp

vicreg_invariance_weight.advice: The default follows the standard VICReg balance.
vicreg_invariance_weight.description: Weight of the VICReg invariance loss between augmented views.
vicreg_invariance_weight.title: Vicreg Invariance Weight

vicreg_variance_weight.advice: The default follows the standard VICReg balance.
vicreg_variance_weight.description: Weight of the VICReg per-dimension variance regularizer.
vicreg_variance_weight.title: Vicreg Variance Weight

vicreg_covariance_weight.advice: The default follows the standard VICReg balance.
vicreg_covariance_weight.description: Weight of the VICReg off-diagonal covariance regularizer.
vicreg_covariance_weight.title: Vicreg Covariance Weight

augmentation_translation_px.advice: Small translations preserve the complete 36 px cell crop without wraparound.
augmentation_translation_px.description: Maximum zero-filled integer translation applied to VICReg image views.
augmentation_translation_px.title: Augmentation Translation Px

augmentation_horizontal_flip_probability.advice: Flips are pixel-preserving and do not interpolate low-resolution IMC data.
augmentation_horizontal_flip_probability.description: Probability of a horizontal flip for each VICReg view.
augmentation_horizontal_flip_probability.title: Augmentation Horizontal Flip Probability

augmentation_vertical_flip_probability.advice: Set to zero to disable this orientation augmentation.
augmentation_vertical_flip_probability.description: Probability of a vertical flip for each VICReg view.
augmentation_vertical_flip_probability.title: Augmentation Vertical Flip Probability

augmentation_rotation_probability.advice: Only right-angle rotations are used, avoiding interpolation at 1 um/pixel.
augmentation_rotation_probability.description: Probability of applying a random 0/90/180/270-degree rotation.
augmentation_rotation_probability.title: Augmentation Rotation Probability

augmentation_translation_probability.advice: Set to zero to disable translations while retaining the configured maximum distance.
augmentation_translation_probability.description: Probability of applying a zero-filled integer translation.
augmentation_translation_probability.title: Augmentation Translation Probability

augmentation_intensity_jitter.advice: No hue, saturation, channel mixing, or artificial background is applied to multiplex IMC images.
augmentation_intensity_jitter.description: Maximum independent multiplicative intensity perturbation per marker channel.
augmentation_intensity_jitter.title: Augmentation Intensity Jitter

augmentation_intensity_jitter_probabilit.advice: The zero default preserves marker amplitude between views; increase deliberately to make the encoder less intensity-sensitive.
augmentation_intensity_jitter_probabilit.description: Probability of applying independent multiplicative marker jitter.
augmentation_intensity_jitter_probabilit.title: Augmentation Intensity Jitter Probability

augmentation_noise_std.advice: Background pixels remain exactly zero in both VICReg views.
augmentation_noise_std.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise applied only on the configured spatial support.
augmentation_noise_std.title: Augmentation Noise Std

augmentation_noise_probability.advice: Set to zero to disable pixel noise for low-resolution IMC.
augmentation_noise_probability.description: Probability of adding Gaussian noise to one augmented view.
augmentation_noise_probability.title: Augmentation Noise Probability

augmentation_noise_support.advice: channel preserves each marker's original nonzero support; segmentation_mask permits noise anywhere inside the extracted cell.
augmentation_noise_support.description: Spatial support on which augmentation noise may be added.
augmentation_noise_support.title: Augmentation Noise Support

n_pcs.advice: The runtime value is capped by the number of cells and embedding dimensions.
n_pcs.description: Single PCA component count used before RAPIDS neighbor construction.
n_pcs.title: N Pcs

n_neighbors.advice: The runtime value is capped below the number of embedded cells.
n_neighbors.description: Single neighbor count used for the RAPIDS cell graph.
n_neighbors.title: N Neighbors

fusion_enabled.advice: The default requires the configured source AnnData to contain fusion_intensity_representation; disable only for a morphology-only analysis.
fusion_enabled.description: Fuse the CellVision morphology graph with a local graph rebuilt from a batch-corrected source intensity representation.
fusion_enabled.title: Fusion Enabled

fusion_intensity_adata_path.advice: Set this when BioBatchNet writes to a separate output_adata_path instead of updating the CellVision source AnnData.
fusion_intensity_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData supplying the batch-corrected intensity representation used for graph fusion; defaults to cellvision.input_adata_path and then general.anndata_path.
fusion_intensity_adata_path.title: Fusion Intensity Adata Path

fusion_intensity_representation.advice: X_biobatchnet is written by the toolkit BioBatchNet stage; latent dimensions are used directly without another PCA.
fusion_intensity_representation.description: Source AnnData obsm key containing the batch-corrected per-cell intensity embedding used to build the fusion graph.
fusion_intensity_representation.title: Fusion Intensity Representation

fusion_intensity_weight.advice: Use 0 for the morphology endpoint, 1 for the intensity endpoint, and intermediate values for joint clustering.
fusion_intensity_weight.description: Weight assigned to the degree-normalized intensity graph; one minus this value weights the CellVision morphology graph.
fusion_intensity_weight.title: Fusion Intensity Weight

leiden_resolutions.advice: Each value creates a namespaced cellvision_leiden_<resolution> annotation and report set.
leiden_resolutions.description: Leiden resolutions evaluated on the default joint CellVision neighbor graph.
leiden_resolutions.title: Leiden Resolutions

umap_min_dist.advice: Use the same value for directly comparable runs.
umap_min_dist.description: Minimum distance used for the CellVision RAPIDS UMAP.
umap_min_dist.title: Umap Min Dist

source_umap_key.advice: Projection is skipped with a warning when this embedding is absent.
source_umap_key.description: Source AnnData obsm key on which new CellVision labels are projected.
source_umap_key.title: Source Umap Key

gallery_cells_per_cluster.advice: Every selected marker is a column; a composite column is added when there are at most three markers.
gallery_cells_per_cluster.description: Maximum randomly sampled cells shown as rows in each Leiden gallery.
gallery_cells_per_cluster.title: Gallery Cells Per Cluster

gallery_max_clusters.advice: Leave unset to generate a gallery for every discovered cluster.
gallery_max_clusters.description: Optional maximum number of Leiden clusters receiving galleries per resolution.
gallery_max_clusters.title: Gallery Max Clusters

figure_dpi.advice: Increase for publication export at the cost of larger reports.
figure_dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch for CellVision raster figures.
figure_dpi.title: Figure Dpi

metadata_conflict.description: Resolution policy for repeated non-null case metadata values.

min_rois_per_case.description: Minimum represented ROIs required per case.

feature_selection_top_n.description: Top univariate image features retained for multivariable models.

specific_rois.description: Exact ROI folder names to process in both DNA restoration and Cellpose-SAM; use null to process every ROI found in the denoised-image folder.
specific_rois.title: Specific Rois

dna_image_name.description: Case-sensitive substring used to identify the nuclear DNA TIFF within each ROI folder. Exactly one filename must contain this value.
dna_image_name.title: Dna Image Name

dna_preprocessing_output_folder_name.description: Project-relative directory that receives one Cellpose3-restored DNA TIFF per ROI and supplies the images subsequently segmented by Cellpose-SAM.
dna_preprocessing_output_folder_name.title: Dna Preprocessing Output Folder Name

cellpose_cell_diameter.advice: Increase when nuclei are fragmented; decrease when neighbouring nuclei are merged.
cellpose_cell_diameter.description: Estimated median nuclear diameter in pixels on the original IMC image. Cellpose3 uses it to determine restoration scale; Cellpose-SAM also uses it when upscaling is disabled.
cellpose_cell_diameter.title: Cellpose Cell Diameter

upscale_ratio.description: Fallback reported and segmentation target-to-input diameter ratio used only for an unrecognised custom upscale_model_type; supported nuclei and cyto3 restorers instead use fixed assumed targets of 17 and 30 pixels.
upscale_ratio.title: Upscale Ratio

expand_masks.description: Number of original-resolution pixels by which to expand each nuclear label after segmentation; expansion stops where neighbouring labels meet and values at or below zero disable it.
expand_masks.title: Expand Masks

perform_qc.description: Generate DNA restoration comparisons and Cellpose-SAM boundary overlays in the QC directory. This does not replace visual review of every biologically distinct tissue or acquisition batch.
perform_qc.title: Perform Qc

qc_boundary_dilation.description: Extra dilation, in display pixels, applied only to mask outlines in QC overlays; it does not alter the saved masks or any downstream measurements.
qc_boundary_dilation.title: Qc Boundary Dilation

min_cell_area.description: Minimum accepted nuclear-object area in pixels. Null is treated as 15; the value is used during Cellpose inference and again on masks restored to the original IMC grid.
min_cell_area.title: Min Cell Area

max_cell_area.description: Legacy absolute maximum-area setting retained for configuration compatibility; the active Cellpose-SAM stage does not read it. Use max_size_fraction for the current upper-size filter.
max_cell_area.title: Max Cell Area

cell_pose_model.description: Legacy Cellpose3 segmentation-model name retained for compatibility; the active two-step stage uses Cellpose3 only for restoration and does not read this field.
cell_pose_model.title: Cell Pose Model

cell_pose_sam_model.description: Cellpose-SAM model identifier or path to a compatible custom model. Use cpsam for the bundled generalist model; obsolete nuclei/cyto model names fall back to cpsam.
cell_pose_sam_model.title: Cell Pose Sam Model

cellprob_threshold.description: Foreground logit threshold for Cellpose-SAM mask formation. Lower values generally admit more pixels and objects; higher values make foreground assignment more conservative.
cellprob_threshold.title: Cellprob Threshold

flow_threshold.description: Maximum Cellpose flow-consistency error accepted for a candidate mask. Lower values reject more irregular masks; higher values retain more candidates, including potential failures.
flow_threshold.title: Flow Threshold

run_deblur.description: Apply the Cellpose3 deblur_nuclei restoration model to each DNA image before any upsampling. The result is intended to aid segmentation, not marker quantification.
run_deblur.title: Run Deblur

run_upscale.description: Apply Cellpose3 learned upsampling before Cellpose-SAM, then return the resulting labels to the original IMC dimensions using nearest-neighbour resizing.
run_upscale.title: Run Upscale

image_normalise.description: Percentile-normalise each restored DNA image inside Cellpose-SAM before inference; disable only when intensities have already been placed on a suitable model-input scale.
image_normalise.title: Image Normalise

image_normalise_percentile_lower.description: Lower per-image percentile mapped to the bottom of the Cellpose-SAM normalisation range when image_normalise is enabled.
image_normalise_percentile_lower.title: Image Normalise Percentile Lower

image_normalise_percentile_upper.description: Upper per-image percentile mapped to the top of the Cellpose-SAM normalisation range when image_normalise is enabled; reducing it increases clipping of bright DNA pixels.
image_normalise_percentile_upper.title: Image Normalise Percentile Upper

dpi_qc_images.description: Resolution in dots per inch for saved restoration and segmentation QC figures; it changes figure rendering only, not segmentation.
dpi_qc_images.title: Dpi Qc Images

max_size_fraction.description: Largest accepted object area as a fraction of the original ROI area in the pipeline's post-filter. Cellpose-SAM also applies its own 0.4 default internally because this field is not forwarded to model inference.
max_size_fraction.title: Max Size Fraction

remove_edge_masks.description: Remove every label that touches an image border after masks are returned to the original IMC grid. Enable when partial border nuclei would bias object-level measurements.
remove_edge_masks.title: Remove Edge Masks

fill_holes.description: Fill enclosed background holes separately within each predicted nuclear label before expansion and area filtering.
fill_holes.title: Fill Holes

batch_size.description: Cellpose-SAM inference batch size used when a GPU is available; CPU execution is forced to a batch size of one. Reduce this value if GPU memory is exhausted.
batch_size.title: Batch Size

resample.description: Legacy inference setting retained for compatibility; the active wrapper does not forward it, so the pinned Cellpose-SAM implementation uses its own default.
resample.title: Resample

augment.description: Enable Cellpose-SAM test-time tiling and flip augmentation. This can change boundaries and increase runtime, so compare QC on representative tissue before adopting it.
augment.title: Augment

tile_overlap.description: Legacy tile-overlap setting retained for compatibility; the active wrapper does not forward it and Cellpose-SAM therefore uses its own 0.1 default.
tile_overlap.title: Tile Overlap

upscale_model_type.description: Cellpose3 restoration model used for learned upsampling. Use upsample_nuclei for IMC DNA (17-pixel training target); upsample_cyto3 targets 30-pixel cellular objects.
upscale_model_type.title: Upscale Model Type

run_parameter_scan.description: Run a two-parameter grid search with separate masks and QC outputs for comparison, rather than produce the canonical masks used downstream. Rerun normally after choosing settings.
run_parameter_scan.title: Run Parameter Scan

param_a.description: Name of the first createmasks field varied by the parameter scan; normally cellprob_threshold.
param_a.title: Param A

param_a_values.description: Candidate values for param_a; each is crossed with every param_b value, so list length directly affects scan runtime and output volume.
param_a_values.title: Param A Values

param_b.description: Name of the second createmasks field varied by the parameter scan; normally flow_threshold.
param_b.title: Param B

param_b_values.description: Candidate values for param_b; each is crossed with every param_a value to form the scan grid.
param_b_values.title: Param B Values

window_size.description: Legacy parameter-scan window size retained for configuration compatibility; the active Cellpose-SAM scan does not read it.
window_size.title: Window Size

num_rois_to_scan.description: Number of available restored ROIs selected at random for a parameter scan when specific_rois is null; selection currently has no fixed random seed.
num_rois_to_scan.title: Num Rois To Scan

scan_rois.description: Legacy scan-specific ROI list retained for configuration compatibility; the active scan does not read it, so use specific_rois to choose ROIs.
scan_rois.title: Scan Rois

run_denoising.description: Run the configured IMC-Denoise restoration method; panel-driven outlier removal and side-by-side QC are controlled separately.
run_denoising.title: Run Denoising

method.description: Restoration method: 'deep_snf' applies DIMR hot-pixel removal followed by self-supervised shot-noise filtering, whereas 'dimr' applies only DIMR.
method.title: Method

channels.description: Channel identifiers to denoise and display in side-by-side QC, matched case-insensitively within ROI TIFF filenames; an empty list selects panel rows marked to_denoise, or use_denoised for older panel files.
channels.title: Channels

n_neighbours.description: Number of locally most distribution-consistent neighbour differences summed by DIMR when classifying a centre pixel as a hot-pixel outlier.
n_neighbours.title: N Neighbours

n_iter.description: Maximum number of iterative DIMR detection-and-median-replacement passes; later passes can remove small adjacent hot-pixel clusters exposed by earlier passes.
n_iter.title: N Iter

window_size.description: Odd-width local DIMR window, in pixels, used to construct neighbour differences and to median-replace detected outliers.
window_size.title: Window Size

remove_outliers.description: Before IMC-Denoise, apply each channel's optional panel.csv remove_outliers rule and overwrite above-threshold pixels with zero in the raw TIFFs; this is a pipeline-specific preprocessing step, not DIMR.
remove_outliers.title: Remove Outliers

max_halo_px.advice: Interpret this in the native pixel grid of the configured raw images and masks.

source_anchor_dilation_px.advice: Unassigned pixels are allocated to their nearest cell; pixels assigned to other cells are excluded.

source_anchor_quantile.advice: High quantiles remain robust to conservative nuclear masks for membrane or cytoplasmic markers.

source_threshold_quantile.advice: The default admits cells in the lower edge of the exemplar-positive brightness regime.

halo_aggregation.advice: Use max normally; sum is more aggressive when several source halos overlap.

n_jobs.advice: Workers load one mask and marker images lazily; avoid nested multiprocessing.

qc_markers.advice: Leave unset to select the most affected markers automatically.

max_qc_markers.advice: Profile and score-summary tables still include every marker.

roi_obs.description: AnnData observation identifying images or regions for which separate spatial graphs are constructed; null uses general.roi_obs.

groupby_obs.description: Optional ROI or case metadata category used to colour and stratify summary plots; it does not filter cells or perform a group-comparison test.
groupby_obs.title: Groupby Obs

x_coord_obs.description: AnnData observation containing cell-centroid x coordinates used to construct each ROI graph; null uses general.x_coord_obs.
x_coord_obs.title: X Coord Obs

y_coord_obs.description: AnnData observation containing cell-centroid y coordinates used to construct each ROI graph; null uses general.y_coord_obs.
y_coord_obs.title: Y Coord Obs

spatial_key.description: Temporary AnnData obsm key under which the configured x/y coordinates are placed before Squidpy graph construction; null uses general.spatial_key.
spatial_key.title: Spatial Key

master_index_obs.description: Optional unique-cell observation carried into the analysis metadata frame for compatibility; it does not alter graph construction or the current NetworkX metrics.
master_index_obs.title: Master Index Obs

include_all_obs_metadata.description: Include all eligible AnnData observations in ROI and case metadata tables; the complete AnnData observation snapshot is written independently of this setting.
include_all_obs_metadata.title: Include All Obs Metadata

metadata_obs_columns.description: Observation columns included in ROI and case metadata tables when include_all_obs_metadata is false; an empty list falls back to general.metadata_obs.
metadata_obs_columns.title: Metadata Obs Columns

ignore_cells_without_label.description: Drop cells with null or blank population labels before constructing ROI graphs; false stops the stage when such labels are present.
ignore_cells_without_label.title: Ignore Cells Without Label

graph_coord_type.description: Squidpy coordinate mode used for graph construction; generic is appropriate for continuous IMC centroids, while grid is intended for lattice-based observations.
graph_coord_type.title: Graph Coord Type

graph_delaunay.description: Use a Delaunay triangulation for generic coordinates instead of the default k-nearest-neighbour graph; graph_n_neighs is ignored in Delaunay mode.
graph_delaunay.title: Graph Delaunay

graph_n_neighs.description: Nearest-neighbour count for the default generic k-nearest-neighbour graph; null lets Squidpy resolve its default, and the value is ignored when radius or Delaunay mode is active.
graph_n_neighs.title: Graph N Neighs

graph_radius.description: Optional spatial edge limit in unconverted coordinate units: one value gives a maximum radius and two values retain an interval; setting it selects or prunes the applicable generic graph mode.
graph_radius.title: Graph Radius

graph_percentile.description: Optional percentile of generic-graph edge distances retained by Squidpy after graph construction; null applies no percentile pruning.
graph_percentile.title: Graph Percentile

graph_transform.description: Optional Squidpy connectivity transform, spectral or cosine; NetworkX metrics are unweighted but any change to the nonzero edge pattern can change their result.
graph_transform.title: Graph Transform

graph_set_diag.description: Ask Squidpy to include self-connectivity before conversion; the active stage subsequently removes every diagonal entry, so self-loops never enter the NetworkX metrics.
graph_set_diag.title: Graph Set Diag

minimum_cells_per_population.description: Minimum number of cells of a population required within an ROI before calculating average clustering on that population's induced subgraph.
minimum_cells_per_population.title: Minimum Cells Per Population

run_bootstrap.description: Compare observed graph metrics with a fixed-graph null generated by permuting population labels within each ROI.
run_bootstrap.title: Run Bootstrap

bootstrap_n_permutations.description: Number of within-ROI population-label permutations used to calculate null means, standard deviations, deltas, and z-scores.
bootstrap_n_permutations.title: Bootstrap N Permutations

bootstrap_static_populations.description: Population labels kept on their original nodes while all remaining labels are permuted among non-static cells within each ROI.
bootstrap_static_populations.title: Bootstrap Static Populations

bootstrap_ddof.description: Delta degrees of freedom used for the standard deviation across permutation metric values.
bootstrap_ddof.title: Bootstrap Ddof

bootstrap_seed.description: Base random seed from which deterministic, independent ROI permutation streams are spawned; null requests non-deterministic streams.
bootstrap_seed.title: Bootstrap Seed

n_threads.description: Number of ROI analyses run concurrently; -1 uses available SLURM or local CPU capacity, capped at the number of ROIs.
n_threads.title: N Threads

save_bootstrap_samples.description: Save every ROI-level and derived case-level permutation metric value in long CSV tables in addition to compact summaries.
save_bootstrap_samples.title: Save Bootstrap Samples

make_plots.description: Generate assortativity and per-population average-clustering summary figures from the saved ROI or case tables.
make_plots.title: Make Plots

plot_kind.description: Summary display type: barplot for means with error bars or boxplot for distributions.
plot_kind.title: Plot Kind

plot_summary_level.description: Unit plotted: case_if_available prefers case means and falls back to ROIs, while case and roi request those levels explicitly.
plot_summary_level.title: Plot Summary Level

plot_value_columns.description: Summary metrics plotted from observed, bootstrap_mean, delta, and zscore; invalid names are ignored and an empty valid selection falls back to observed and zscore.
plot_value_columns.title: Plot Value Columns

make_all_populations_plots.description: Plot average-clustering results for all selected populations on one axis, using groupby_obs as hue when available.
make_all_populations_plots.title: Make All Populations Plots

all_populations_plot_populations.description: Optional ordered population subset shown in combined average-clustering plots; an empty list shows every population in annotation order.
all_populations_plot_populations.title: All Populations Plot Populations

all_populations_figsize.description: Optional fixed width and height in inches for combined population plots; null calculates width from the number of displayed populations.
all_populations_figsize.title: All Populations Figsize

make_population_group_plots.description: When groupby_obs is available, save one average-clustering figure per population comparing the configured groups.
make_population_group_plots.title: Make Population Group Plots

make_assortativity_group_plots.description: Save whole-graph assortativity plots, stratified by groupby_obs when that metadata is available.
make_assortativity_group_plots.title: Make Assortativity Group Plots

barplot_figsize.description: Base width and height in inches for NetworkX spatial summary plots.
barplot_figsize.title: Barplot Figsize

all_populations_width_scale.description: Automatic combined-population plot width in inches per population, subject to barplot_figsize as a minimum.
all_populations_width_scale.title: All Populations Width Scale

barplot_add_points.description: Overlay individual case or ROI observations on summary plots so replication and heterogeneity remain visible.
barplot_add_points.title: Barplot Add Points

figure_extension.description: File extension, including the leading dot, used for NetworkX spatial figures.
figure_extension.title: Figure Extension

figure_dpi.description: Raster resolution in dots per inch for saved NetworkX spatial figures.
figure_dpi.title: Figure Dpi

output_dir.description: Directory for normalization_dict.json, master cell tables, and optional per-ROI Nimbus confidence maps. Relative paths resolve from the project working directory.
output_dir.title: Output Dir

roi_table_subfolder.description: Subdirectory below general.celltable_folder for ROI-level Nimbus cell tables; use an empty string to write them directly into general.celltable_folder.
roi_table_subfolder.title: Roi Table Subfolder

master_celltable.description: Filename or path for the combined cell table containing mask geometry and per-marker Nimbus scores. Relative paths are placed below output_dir; an empty value falls back to segmentation.celltable_output.
master_celltable.title: Master Celltable

master_classic_celltable.description: Filename or path for conventional mean image intensities measured inside each adjusted cell mask. Relative paths are placed below output_dir.
master_classic_celltable.title: Master Classic Celltable

master_expansion_celltable.description: Filename or path for mean image intensities measured after independently dilating each adjusted cell mask. Relative paths are placed below output_dir.
master_expansion_celltable.title: Master Expansion Celltable

anndata_output.description: Deprecated compatibility path for the AnnData output. The current pipeline writes the canonical general.anndata_path and warns when this value differs.
anndata_output.title: Anndata Output

roi_table_prefix.description: Prefix added to each ROI name when writing ROI-level cell-table CSV filenames.
roi_table_prefix.title: Roi Table Prefix

use_denoised_first.description: Deprecated compatibility setting not consulted by the current Nimbus stage. Image preference is selected per channel by panel.csv use_denoised and use_raw flags.
use_denoised_first.title: Use Denoised First

allow_raw_fallback.description: When a channel's panel-selected denoised or raw image is unavailable, also search the other image folder before declaring the channel missing.
allow_raw_fallback.title: Allow Raw Fallback

simple_image_names.description: Match channel TIFFs using channel_label.tiff rather than the default channel_name_channel_label filename hint derived from panel.csv.
simple_image_names.title: Simple Image Names

mask_extensions.description: Ordered filename extensions used to discover ROI label masks in general.masks_folder.
mask_extensions.title: Mask Extensions

mask_boundary_offset_pixels.description: Number of pixels by which to modify every cell mask before Nimbus scoring and all intensity extraction: positive values expand labels without overlap and negative values erode cells independently.
mask_boundary_offset_pixels.title: Mask Boundary Offset Pixels

min_cell_area.description: Optional minimum cell area in pixels after mask-boundary adjustment; smaller labels are removed from Nimbus, cell tables, and AnnData.
min_cell_area.title: Min Cell Area

max_cell_area.description: Optional maximum cell area in pixels after mask-boundary adjustment; larger labels are removed from Nimbus, cell tables, and AnnData.
max_cell_area.title: Max Cell Area

test_time_augmentation.description: Average confidence maps predicted from 90-degree rotations and horizontal or vertical flips. This usually improves robustness but increases inference time.
test_time_augmentation.title: Test Time Augmentation

batch_size.description: Maximum number of image tiles processed together by tiled Nimbus inference; reduce it when accelerator memory is insufficient.
batch_size.title: Batch Size

model_magnification.description: Magnification expected by the selected Nimbus checkpoint. Inputs are rescaled from dataset_magnification to this value before inference.
model_magnification.title: Model Magnification

dataset_magnification.description: Magnification represented by the supplied channel images and masks. Set this to the true input scale so image and mask data are rescaled consistently for the model.
dataset_magnification.title: Dataset Magnification

checkpoint.description: Nimbus model checkpoint. 'latest' checks Hugging Face for the newest V*.pt file and falls back to a cached checkpoint; any other value must name a local packaged checkpoint.
checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

device.description: Torch inference device: 'auto' prefers Apple MPS, then CUDA, then CPU; explicit supported values are 'mps', 'cuda', and 'cpu'.
device.title: Device

normalization_quantile.description: Per-ROI, in-mask image quantile calculated for each channel; values are averaged across all usable ROIs to obtain the channel divisor before Nimbus inference.
normalization_quantile.title: Normalization Quantile

normalization_subset.description: Maximum number of randomly sampled ROIs displayed in each normalization QC gallery. Normalization itself uses all usable ROIs; set to 0 to skip the galleries.
normalization_subset.title: Normalization Subset

normalization_jobs.description: Compatibility setting for normalization concurrency. The current toolkit wrapper calculates normalization serially, so this value does not presently change execution.
normalization_jobs.title: Normalization Jobs

normalization_clip.description: Compatibility bounds used by normalization QC, whose second value sets the displayed upper clip. The pinned Nimbus loader clips inference images to [0, 1].
normalization_clip.title: Normalization Clip

normalization_min_value.description: Positive lower bound applied to computed channel normalization divisors, preventing near-zero background estimates from amplifying noise.
normalization_min_value.title: Normalization Min Value

reuse_saved_normalization.description: Load output_dir/normalization_dict.json instead of recomputing channel divisors. Finite positive manual values are retained and normalization QC is still regenerated.
reuse_saved_normalization.title: Reuse Saved Normalization

norm_dict_qc_only.description: Stop after writing or loading normalization_dict.json and generating normalization QC; do not run Nimbus, extract intensities, or create cell tables and AnnData.
norm_dict_qc_only.title: Norm Dict Qc Only

save_prediction_maps.description: Save each per-pixel Nimbus confidence map as an 8-bit TIFF under an ROI subdirectory of output_dir. Per-cell floating-point scores are produced regardless.
save_prediction_maps.title: Save Prediction Maps

allow_prediction_resize.description: On an unexpected confidence-map versus mask shape mismatch, resize the prediction to the mask instead of failing. Enable only as a diagnosed fallback because resizing can alter cell-level scores.
allow_prediction_resize.title: Allow Prediction Resize

use_existing_master_celltables.description: Reuse valid existing Nimbus, classic, and expansion master CSVs where available. This is automatically disabled when mask offsets or area filters could make tables stale.
use_existing_master_celltables.title: Use Existing Master Celltables

extract_classic_intensities.description: Also calculate conventional mean source-image intensity inside each adjusted cell mask and add raw and marker-normalized AnnData layers.
extract_classic_intensities.title: Extract Classic Intensities

extract_expansion_intensities.description: Also calculate mean source-image intensity after independently dilating each adjusted cell mask and add raw and marker-normalized AnnData layers.
extract_expansion_intensities.title: Extract Expansion Intensities

expansion_pixels.description: Number of binary-dilation iterations applied independently to each cell for expansion intensity extraction; expanded regions may overlap and include neighbouring signal.
expansion_pixels.title: Expansion Pixels

expansion_jobs.description: ROI-level worker processes for expansion extraction: 1 is sequential, -1 requests all available CPUs, and values above 1 request that many workers subject to ROI and CPU counts.
expansion_jobs.title: Expansion Jobs

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input override; null uses the pipeline-managed general AnnData path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_subdir.description: Subdirectory below the active QC or managed report location for pairwise spatial tables, plots, and metadata.
output_subdir.title: Output Subdir

reload_saved_results.description: Reuse structurally complete raw Squidpy, distance, and PCF tables when present, allowing plot-only reruns without repeating the analyses.
reload_saved_results.title: Reload Saved Results

population_obs.description: AnnData observation containing the target population labels; null uses general.population_obs_primary, then the legacy population column.
population_obs.title: Population Obs

groupby_obs.description: Optional AnnData observation used to stratify ROI results into biological or experimental groups; null uses general.groupby_obs.
groupby_obs.title: Groupby Obs

groupby_obs_groups.description: Optional ordered subset of groupby_obs categories retained for every analysis and plot; null uses general.groupby_obs_groups.
groupby_obs_groups.title: Groupby Obs Groups

roi_obs.description: AnnData observation identifying independent images or regions within which spatial relationships are calculated; null uses general.roi_obs.
roi_obs.title: Roi Obs

x_coord_obs.description: AnnData observation containing cell-centroid x coordinates; null uses general.x_coord_obs and values are assumed to be in the units named by the distance settings.
x_coord_obs.title: X Coord Obs

y_coord_obs.description: AnnData observation containing cell-centroid y coordinates; null uses general.y_coord_obs and values are assumed to be in the units named by the distance settings.
y_coord_obs.title: Y Coord Obs

master_index_obs.description: AnnData observation uniquely identifying cells when distance results are mapped back to their original source populations; null uses general.master_index_obs.
master_index_obs.title: Master Index Obs

source_population_obs.description: Optional separate observation used to group anchor cells in nearest-distance summaries; null uses population_obs for both source and target identities.
source_population_obs.title: Source Population Obs

include_all_obs_metadata.description: Include every AnnData observation column in the saved cell snapshot and eligible ROI metadata exports.
include_all_obs_metadata.title: Include All Obs Metadata

metadata_obs_columns.description: Additional AnnData observation columns exported with ROI-level results when include_all_obs_metadata is false; an empty list falls back to general.metadata_obs.
metadata_obs_columns.title: Metadata Obs Columns

run_squidpy_interactions.description: Build a radius graph separately within each configured subregion and calculate Squidpy observed edge counts and label-permutation z-scores for every population pair.
run_squidpy_interactions.title: Run Squidpy Interactions

squidpy_subregion_obs.description: AnnData observation whose categories are analysed separately by Squidpy; null uses roi_obs, which normally produces one graph and interaction matrix per ROI.
squidpy_subregion_obs.title: Squidpy Subregion Obs

squidpy_subregion_suffix.description: Suffix appended to squidpy_subregion_obs when selecting the Squidpy library key used to prevent graph edges across spatial units.
squidpy_subregion_suffix.title: Squidpy Subregion Suffix

squidpy_radius_min_um.description: Lower distance bound passed to Squidpy radius-graph construction, in the unconverted units of the configured centroid coordinates.
squidpy_radius_min_um.title: Squidpy Radius Min Um

squidpy_radius_max_um.description: Upper distance bound passed to Squidpy radius-graph construction; cells within this annular range are treated as neighbours.
squidpy_radius_max_um.title: Squidpy Radius Max Um

squidpy_n_permutations.description: Number of within-subregion population-label permutations used by Squidpy to estimate the null mean and standard deviation of interaction counts.
squidpy_n_permutations.title: Squidpy N Permutations

run_distance_bootstrap.description: Measure each cell's nearest target-population distance and compare it with distances obtained after repeatedly permuting target labels within each ROI.
run_distance_bootstrap.title: Run Distance Bootstrap

distance_populations.description: Optional ordered target-population subset for nearest-distance analysis; null evaluates every observed target population.
distance_populations.title: Distance Populations

distance_roi_ids.description: Optional subset of ROI identifiers included in nearest-distance analysis; null evaluates every ROI.
distance_roi_ids.title: Distance Roi Ids

distance_n_bootstraps.description: Number of within-ROI target-label permutations used to form the nearest-distance null distribution; these are permutations, not resampled biological replicates.
distance_n_bootstraps.title: Distance N Bootstraps

distance_n_jobs.description: Joblib worker count for distance permutations; -1 uses all available CPU cores.
distance_n_jobs.title: Distance N Jobs

distance_ddof.description: Delta degrees of freedom used when calculating the standard deviation of permuted cell-level distances for distance z-scores.
distance_ddof.title: Distance Ddof

ignore_cells_without_label.description: Drop cells missing required source or target population labels during distance analysis; false stops with an error instead.
ignore_cells_without_label.title: Ignore Cells Without Label

run_pcf.description: Calculate edge-corrected cross-pair-correlation functions for every ordered population pair and report g(r) at one selected distance bin.
run_pcf.title: Run Pcf

pcf_target_distance_um.description: Requested lower-radius value at which PCF summaries are extracted; the nearest available radius-step bin is used and reported as evaluated_um.
pcf_target_distance_um.title: Pcf Target Distance Um

pcf_max_radius_um.description: Outer extent of the PCF curve in the unconverted units of the configured coordinates.
pcf_max_radius_um.title: Pcf Max Radius Um

pcf_radius_step_um.description: Width of each PCF annulus and spacing between reported lower-radius values; with 10 and target 20, g is calculated for distances greater than 20 and at most 30.
pcf_radius_step_um.title: Pcf Radius Step Um

pcf_num_bootstrap.description: Number of 100-by-100 spatial-grid resamples used to estimate condition-level PCF confidence bounds.
pcf_num_bootstrap.title: Pcf Num Bootstrap

pcf_cluster_column.description: Column name assigned to population labels in the exported SpOOx-style PCF statistics table; it is not an AnnData input key.
pcf_cluster_column.title: Pcf Cluster Column

pcf_samples.description: Optional ordered subset of ROI identifiers included in PCF analysis; null uses every ROI.
pcf_samples.title: Pcf Samples

population_pairs.description: Source-to-target population selections used only for focused barplots; supports direct or observation-nested mappings plus ALL, ALL_OTHERS, MATCH_x, and NOT_x target tokens.
population_pairs.title: Population Pairs

make_matrix_plots.description: Save population-by-population heatmaps or clustermaps for each available Squidpy, distance, and PCF metric.
make_matrix_plots.title: Make Matrix Plots

make_pair_barplots.description: Save ROI-level barplots for source-target combinations selected by population_pairs.
make_pair_barplots.title: Make Pair Barplots

heatmap_use_clustermap.description: Use seaborn clustermaps for pairwise matrices when possible; false uses fixed-order heatmaps.
heatmap_use_clustermap.title: Heatmap Use Clustermap

heatmap_row_cluster.description: Hierarchically reorder source-population rows when clustermap plotting is enabled.
heatmap_row_cluster.title: Heatmap Row Cluster

heatmap_col_cluster.description: Hierarchically reorder target-population columns when clustermap plotting is enabled.
heatmap_col_cluster.title: Heatmap Col Cluster

heatmap_figsize.description: Base pairwise-matrix figure width and height in inches.
