heatmap_percentile.description: Percentile of finite matrix magnitudes used to limit heatmap colour ranges and reduce domination by extreme values.
heatmap_percentile.title: Heatmap Percentile

SpatialDataMaxFuseTableConfig.description: One matched transcriptome AnnData linked to the primary IMC table.
SpatialDataMaxFuseTableConfig.title: SpatialDataMaxFuseTableConfig

SpatialDataRegionLabelsConfig.description: One categorical raster collection and its value-to-name mapping.
SpatialDataRegionLabelsConfig.title: SpatialDataRegionLabelsConfig

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input override; null uses the pipeline-managed general AnnData path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData output override; null updates the pipeline-managed general AnnData path.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

qc_output_subdir.description: Subdirectory below the active QC or managed report location for STARLING tables, plots, and training logs.
qc_output_subdir.title: Qc Output Subdir

starling_repo_path.description: Optional local STARLING repository prepended to Python's import path; null imports the biostarling installation from the active environment.
starling_repo_path.title: Starling Repo Path

use_layer.description: Optional adata.layers key supplying the non-negative cell-by-marker matrix; null uses adata.X, and this stage applies no normalization or transformation.
use_layer.title: Use Layer

marker_include.description: Optional ordered marker subset used to fit STARLING; null starts from every adata.var_names feature before applying marker_exclude, and at least 10 must remain.
marker_include.title: Marker Include

marker_exclude.description: Exact marker names removed from the selected STARLING feature set, commonly used to exclude DNA, control, morphology, or technically unreliable channels.
marker_exclude.title: Marker Exclude

clip_small_negative_values.description: Replace negative values with zero only when the matrix minimum lies within negative_value_tolerance; larger negative values always stop the stage.
clip_small_negative_values.title: Clip Small Negative Values

negative_value_tolerance.description: Absolute numerical tolerance below zero within which tiny floating-point residuals may be clipped when clip_small_negative_values is enabled.
negative_value_tolerance.title: Negative Value Tolerance

initial_clustering_method.description: Cluster initialization used to seed STARLING centroids and cluster count: User labels, KM K-means, diagonal GMM, FS FlowSOM, or PG PhenoGraph.
initial_clustering_method.title: Initial Clustering Method

initial_label_obs.description: AnnData observation containing complete starting labels in User mode; null falls back to general.population_obs_primary.
initial_label_obs.title: Initial Label Obs

n_clusters.description: Requested number of starting clusters for KM, GMM, or FS initialization; required for those methods and ignored for User and PG.
n_clusters.title: N Clusters

seed.description: Random seed applied through Lightning, including worker seeding, before initialization, synthetic-error generation, and model fitting.
seed.title: Seed

dist_option.description: Per-marker likelihood family: T uses a heavy-tailed Student-t distribution with 2 degrees of freedom, while N uses a Normal distribution.
dist_option.title: Dist Option

singlet_prop.description: Documented initial singlet proportion, optimized rather than enforced as the final fraction; the reviewed upstream 0.1.4 code reverses this value when initializing its singlet/error branches, so verify version behavior before tuning it.
singlet_prop.title: Singlet Prop

model_cell_size.description: Include positive segmented-cell area as an additional phenotype-dependent signal when estimating singlet and segmentation-error probabilities.
model_cell_size.title: Model Cell Size

cell_size_col_name.description: Preferred adata.obs column containing positive cell-mask areas when model_cell_size is enabled.
cell_size_col_name.title: Cell Size Col Name

cell_size_fallback_cols.description: Ordered fallback adata.obs columns searched when cell_size_col_name is absent; the first complete, numeric, strictly positive column is used.
cell_size_fallback_cols.title: Cell Size Fallback Cols

model_zplane_overlap.description: Request STARLING's overlapping-section model, in which a combined segment may have an area between the larger constituent cell and their summed areas; also controls synthetic-error area generation.
model_zplane_overlap.title: Model Zplane Overlap

model_regularizer.description: Multiplier on binary cross-entropy for on-the-fly synthetic singlet/error discrimination relative to the observed-data negative log-likelihood; the paper recommends 0.1, whereas this pipeline defaults to 1.0.
model_regularizer.title: Model Regularizer

learning_rate.description: Adam optimizer learning rate for STARLING's cluster, mixture, and segmentation-error parameters.
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

doublet_threshold.description: Threshold above which the inferred segmentation-error probability is written as a binary doublet/error call; it changes the call, not the fitted probabilities or phenotype label.
doublet_threshold.title: Doublet Threshold

max_epochs.description: Maximum Lightning training epochs for the single STARLING fit; null delegates epoch selection to Lightning defaults.
max_epochs.title: Max Epochs

early_stopping.description: Stop fitting when the monitored training metric ceases to improve according to Lightning's EarlyStopping defaults.
early_stopping.title: Early Stopping

early_stopping_monitor.description: Lightning metric monitored in minimization mode for early stopping; STARLING logs train_loss, train_nll, and train_bce but has no validation loop here.
early_stopping_monitor.title: Early Stopping Monitor

trainer_accelerator.description: Lightning accelerator selection such as auto, cpu, gpu, or mps; auto chooses from resources visible in the Starling environment.
trainer_accelerator.title: Trainer Accelerator

trainer_devices.description: Optional number of devices passed to Lightning; null retains Lightning's automatic device selection.
trainer_devices.title: Trainer Devices

trainer_precision.description: Optional Lightning numerical-precision setting; null uses the installed Lightning default and non-default precision should be validated against STARLING's double-precision inputs.
trainer_precision.title: Trainer Precision

enable_checkpointing.description: Enable Lightning's automatic training checkpoints; these are separate from the explicit reusable model saved by save_model.
enable_checkpointing.title: Enable Checkpointing

enable_progress_bar.description: Show Lightning's interactive training progress bar in the stage log.
enable_progress_bar.title: Enable Progress Bar

log_every_n_steps.description: Optional Lightning interval, in optimizer steps, for recording training metrics; null uses the installed Lightning default.
log_every_n_steps.title: Log Every N Steps

limit_train_batches.description: Optional Lightning training-data limit: an integer selects a batch count and a float from 0 to 1 selects a fraction per epoch; null uses all batches.
limit_train_batches.title: Limit Train Batches

tensorboard_logging.description: Write Lightning training metrics to a TensorBoard log below the STARLING QC directory.
tensorboard_logging.title: Tensorboard Logging

output_prefix.description: Prefix cleaned and applied to STARLING observation, multidimensional, centroid, metadata, table, and plot keys to avoid collisions between runs.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

write_canonical_starling_keys.description: Also write upstream unprefixed keys such as st_label, doublet_prob, and assignment_prob_matrix; enabling this may overwrite existing STARLING results.
write_canonical_starling_keys.title: Write Canonical Starling Keys

store_assignment_prob_matrix.description: Store the N-by-C joint singlet-and-cluster posterior matrix in adata.obsm; rows do not generally sum to one because their sum is the cell's singlet probability.
store_assignment_prob_matrix.title: Store Assignment Prob Matrix

store_gamma_assignment_prob_matrix.description: Store the N-by-C-by-C posterior matrix for all ordered phenotype pairs contributing to a segmentation error; memory use grows quadratically with cluster count.
store_gamma_assignment_prob_matrix.title: Store Gamma Assignment Prob Matrix

save_model.description: Serialize the complete trained STARLING Lightning object with torch.save for reuse or inspection; this can be version-sensitive and is not needed to read saved cell results.
save_model.title: Save Model

model_output_name.description: Model output path used when save_model is enabled; a relative path is resolved as a reusable project asset rather than below the transient run directory.
model_output_name.title: Model Output Name

save_qc_tables.description: Write initialization mappings, initial and fitted centroids, cluster counts, error calls by cluster, run summary, and per-cell results as CSV files.
save_qc_tables.title: Save Qc Tables

save_qc_plots.description: Write histograms of segmentation-error and maximum joint assignment probabilities plus a STARLING cluster-count bar chart.
save_qc_plots.title: Save Qc Plots

figure_format.description: Filename extension for STARLING QC plots, supplied without a leading dot.
figure_format.title: Figure Format

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input override. When omitted, the stage uses general.anndata_path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

output_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData output override. When omitted, the input AnnData is updated in place.
output_adata_path.title: Output Adata Path

output_subdir.description: Directory containing the reusable settings, marker-list, remap, and mapping CSV files.
output_subdir.title: Output Subdir

mode.description: Checkpoint selection: 'generate' runs template creation or subclustering, 'apply' applies the curated remap, 'all' runs all available checkpoints, and 1, 2, or 3 selects one checkpoint directly.
mode.title: Mode

settings_filename.description: Editable per-population settings table. The legacy 'sublustering' spelling is retained for compatibility.
settings_filename.title: Settings Filename

marker_list_filename.description: Editable marker-selection table whose Boolean columns beginning with 'markers_' define alternative feature panels.
marker_list_filename.title: Marker List Filename

remap_filename.description: Editable table mapping each generated subcluster to a biologically curated final population label.
remap_filename.title: Remap Filename

master_index_mapping_filename.description: Output audit table linking each cell's stable master index to its final population label.
master_index_mapping_filename.title: Master Index Mapping Filename

base_label_key.description: Parent-population observation used to define subsets. Defaults to general.population_obs_primary and then the legacy 'population' column.
base_label_key.title: Base Label Key

default_resolution.description: Initial Leiden resolution written to newly generated settings rows; larger values usually produce finer partitions but do not specify an exact number of subclusters.
default_resolution.title: Default Resolution

default_marker_list.description: Initial marker-list name written to settings rows; for example 'all' selects the marker_list.csv column 'markers_all'.
default_marker_list.title: Default Marker List

use_rep.description: Preferred AnnData representation for computing a missing global QC UMAP. Subcluster neighbour graphs themselves are built from the selected marker values in adata.X.
use_rep.title: Use Rep

compute_umap_if_missing.description: Compute a global UMAP for diagnostic plots when adata.obsm['X_umap'] is absent.
compute_umap_if_missing.title: Compute Umap If Missing

umap_dot_size.description: Point size used in subclustering UMAP diagnostics.
umap_dot_size.title: Umap Dot Size

matrixplot_vmax.description: Upper colour limit used for raw-value marker matrix plots; tune it to the scale stored in adata.X.
matrixplot_vmax.title: Matrixplot Vmax

save_individual_umaps.description: Save a separate global UMAP highlighting the cells in every generated subcluster.
save_individual_umaps.title: Save Individual Umaps

figure_extension.description: File extension for subclustering diagnostic figures, including the leading dot.
figure_extension.title: Figure Extension

figure_dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch for saved diagnostic figures.
figure_dpi.title: Figure Dpi

final_label_key.description: AnnData observation column receiving the curated final population labels during the apply checkpoint.
final_label_key.title: Final Label Key

master_index_obs.description: Stable cell-identifier observation used in the exported mapping table. Defaults to general.master_index_obs and then 'Master_Index'; observation names are used if neither exists.
master_index_obs.title: Master Index Obs

apply_remap_only_if_modified.description: Skip remap application until at least one final_population value differs from its generated subcluster label, protecting an unreviewed template from being treated as curated annotation.
apply_remap_only_if_modified.title: Apply Remap Only If Modified

input_adata_path.description: Optional AnnData input override; when omitted, the stage uses general.anndata_path.
input_adata_path.title: Input Adata Path

population_columns.description: Observation columns to treat as population annotations. Defaults to general.population_obs_all, then general.population_obs_primary, then name-based auto-detection.
population_columns.title: Population Columns

metadata_columns.description: Categorical observation columns to visualise as sample or experimental metadata. Defaults to general.metadata_obs and then dictionary/name-based auto-detection.
metadata_columns.title: Metadata Columns

groupby_obs.description: Observation defining biological comparison groups for abundance analysis; defaults to general.groupby_obs.
groupby_obs.title: Groupby Obs

groupby_obs_groups.description: Ordered subset of groupby_obs categories to compare; defaults to the shared general pairwise/group selections.
groupby_obs_groups.title: Groupby Obs Groups

enable_ai.description: Send summary statistics for existing Leiden clusters to the configured OpenAI call and add its provisional cluster names as *_AIlabel columns.
enable_ai.title: Enable Ai

tissue.description: Free-text tissue context included in the AI prompt to help it interpret the marker summaries.
tissue.title: Tissue

repeat_ai_interpretation.description: Run AI interpretation again when any AnnData observation column ending in *_AIlabel already exists.
repeat_ai_interpretation.title: Repeat Ai Interpretation

create_umaps.description: Create UMAP plots from the existing adata.obsm['X_umap'] coordinates.
create_umaps.title: Create Umaps

create_matrix_plots.description: Create mean-marker matrix plots grouped by population and, optionally, metadata annotations.
create_matrix_plots.title: Create Matrix Plots

create_tissue_overlays.description: Project population labels back into each labelled segmentation mask to show their tissue distribution.
create_tissue_overlays.title: Create Tissue Overlays

create_population_analysis.description: Create population count, proportion, density, case-summary, and comparison outputs where the required metadata are available.
create_population_analysis.title: Create Population Analysis

create_backgating.description: Create image-based backgating views that return annotated cells to their source channel images for validation.
create_backgating.title: Create Backgating

create_color_legends.description: Save standalone category-to-colour legends for configured population and metadata columns.
create_color_legends.title: Create Color Legends

include_metadata_umaps.description: Colour the existing UMAP by configured categorical metadata as well as population labels.
include_metadata_umaps.title: Include Metadata Umaps

include_metadata_matrix_plots.description: Summarise mean marker values for groups defined by configured categorical metadata.
include_metadata_matrix_plots.title: Include Metadata Matrix Plots

include_marker_umaps.description: Create per-marker UMAPs plus marker galleries for adata.X and every available AnnData layer.
include_marker_umaps.title: Include Marker Umaps

umap_plot_individual_highlights.description: For each population annotation, save an additional UMAP highlighting every category separately.
umap_plot_individual_highlights.title: Umap Plot Individual Highlights

max_categories.description: Maximum number of unique values allowed when auto-selecting categorical population or metadata columns.
max_categories.title: Max Categories

umap_marker_colormap.description: Matplotlib colormap used for continuous marker-expression UMAPs.
umap_marker_colormap.title: Umap Marker Colormap

umap_marker_gallery_default_colorbar_lab.description: Colour-bar label for the adata.X marker gallery; change this when adata.X contains another measurement scale.
umap_marker_gallery_default_colorbar_lab.title: Umap Marker Gallery Default Colorbar Label

umap_marker_gallery_vmax.description: Optional common upper colour limit for marker UMAP galleries; use null to scale each gallery automatically.
umap_marker_gallery_vmax.title: Umap Marker Gallery Vmax

backgating_cells_per_group.description: Maximum number of example cells sampled for each population's thumbnail gallery.
backgating_cells_per_group.title: Backgating Cells Per Group

backgating_radius.description: Half-width in image pixels of the square crop around each backgated cell centroid.
backgating_radius.title: Backgating Radius

backgating_output_folder.description: Subdirectory under the visualisation output root for image-based population validation outputs.
backgating_output_folder.title: Backgating Output Folder

backgating_use_masks.description: Use segmentation masks to identify cells and draw cell boundaries in backgating images.
backgating_use_masks.title: Backgating Use Masks

backgating_mask_folder.description: Mask directory passed to the backgating implementation; it must correspond to the source channel images and cell identifiers.
backgating_mask_folder.title: Backgating Mask Folder

backgating_pops_list.description: Optional populations to backgate, supplied per population-observation column or under a 'default' key; null processes all populations.
backgating_pops_list.title: Backgating Pops List

backgating_max_rois_to_save.description: Optional maximum number of randomly selected ROI image sets saved per population; intensity normalisation still uses all eligible ROIs.
backgating_max_rois_to_save.title: Backgating Max Rois To Save

backgating_minimum.description: Lower display bound used when rescaling source-channel intensities for backgating composites.
backgating_minimum.title: Backgating Minimum

backgating_max_quantile.description: Upper intensity-rescaling rule for backgating images; the default uses the 99th percentile.
backgating_max_quantile.title: Backgating Max Quantile

backgating_number_top_markers.description: Number of automatically selected discriminative markers assigned to RGB channels for each population.
backgating_number_top_markers.title: Backgating Number Top Markers

backgating_specify_blue.description: Optional fixed blue-channel marker, normally a DNA channel for nuclear context.
backgating_specify_blue.title: Backgating Specify Blue

backgating_specify_red.description: Optional fixed red-channel marker; null uses the first automatically selected population marker.
backgating_specify_red.title: Backgating Specify Red

backgating_specify_green.description: Optional fixed green-channel marker; null uses the next automatically selected population marker.
backgating_specify_green.title: Backgating Specify Green

backgating_use_differential_expression.description: Select RGB markers using a one-population-versus-rest Scanpy ranking instead of population mean expression alone.
backgating_use_differential_expression.title: Backgating Use Differential Expression

backgating_de_method.description: Scanpy marker-ranking method for backgating: typically 'wilcoxon', 't-test', or 'logreg'.
backgating_de_method.title: Backgating De Method

backgating_min_logfc_threshold.description: Preferred minimum log fold change for automatically selected backgating markers; ranking falls back to all markers if too few pass.
backgating_min_logfc_threshold.title: Backgating Min Logfc Threshold

backgating_max_pval_adj.description: Adjusted-P-value threshold reported during backgating marker selection; it does not itself exclude markers from selection.
backgating_max_pval_adj.title: Backgating Max Pval Adj

backgating_markers_exclude.description: Markers excluded from automatic backgating marker selection, usually DNA or technical channels.
backgating_markers_exclude.title: Backgating Markers Exclude

backgating_mode.description: Backgating workflow mode: 'full' selects markers and makes images, 'save_markers' only writes editable settings, and 'load_markers' makes images from existing settings.
backgating_mode.title: Backgating Mode

backgating_population_overlay_outline_wi.description: Contour width in pixels around target cells in backgating population overlays.
backgating_population_overlay_outline_wi.title: Backgating Population Overlay Outline Width

backgating_population_overlay_legend_fon.description: Font size for marker and population labels on backgating overlays.
backgating_population_overlay_legend_fon.title: Backgating Population Overlay Legend Fontsize

backgating_population_overlay_crop_size.description: Optional overlay crop size as [width, height] pixels; null retains the complete ROI.
backgating_population_overlay_crop_size.title: Backgating Population Overlay Crop Size

backgating_population_overlay_crop_origi.description: Crop placement: a named corner, 'center', or 'intelligent' to favour a region containing target cells.
backgating_population_overlay_crop_origi.title: Backgating Population Overlay Crop Origin

backgating_population_overlay_show_scale.description: Draw a scale bar on cropped population overlays.
backgating_population_overlay_show_scale.title: Backgating Population Overlay Show Scale Bar

backgating_population_overlay_scale_bar_.description: Scale-bar length in image pixels; this is not automatically converted to micrometres.
backgating_population_overlay_scale_bar_.title: Backgating Population Overlay Scale Bar Length
Backgating Population Overlay Scale Bar Thickness

matrixplot_vmax.description: Upper colour limit for unscaled mean-marker matrix plots; tune it to the measurement scale in adata.X.
matrixplot_vmax.title: Matrixplot Vmax

matrixplot_use_row_colors.description: Use the toolkit matrix-plot helper to display group colours beside rows, falling back to Scanpy when unavailable.
matrixplot_use_row_colors.title: Matrixplot Use Row Colors

abundance_make_all_populations_plots.description: Create combined abundance plots showing every population on one axis and comparison group as colour.
abundance_make_all_populations_plots.title: Abundance Make All Populations Plots

abundance_all_populations_figsize.description: Minimum [width, height] in inches for combined all-population abundance plots.
abundance_all_populations_figsize.title: Abundance All Populations Figsize

abundance_all_populations_width_scale.description: Additional plot width in inches per population used when automatically sizing combined abundance plots.
abundance_all_populations_width_scale.title: Abundance All Populations Width Scale

abundance_make_case_stacked_plots.description: Create stacked case-level composition plots for all cases and separately for each comparison group.
abundance_make_case_stacked_plots.title: Abundance Make Case Stacked Plots

abundance_case_stacked_figsize.description: Minimum [width, height] in inches for case-level stacked composition plots.
abundance_case_stacked_figsize.title: Abundance Case Stacked Figsize

abundance_case_stacked_width_scale.description: Additional plot width in inches per case used when automatically sizing stacked plots.
abundance_case_stacked_width_scale.title: Abundance Case Stacked Width Scale

abundance_order_cases_by_population.description: Optional population label whose descending case abundance determines the order of stacked bars.
abundance_order_cases_by_population.title: Abundance Order Cases By Population

abundance_plot_style.description: Abundance display style: 'bar' shows summaries, while 'strip' or 'swarm' shows individual ROI or case values with mean and standard-error overlays.
abundance_plot_style.title: Abundance Plot Style

abundance_barplot_y_scale.description: Y-axis mode ('linear', 'log', or 'intelligent') specified globally or by abundance metric.
abundance_barplot_y_scale.title: Abundance Barplot Y Scale

abundance_barplot_y_scale_intelligent_pa.description: Thresholds controlling when intelligent abundance scaling switches a positive, wide, skewed distribution to a logarithmic axis.
abundance_barplot_y_scale_intelligent_pa.title: Abundance Barplot Y Scale Intelligent Params

save_high_res.description: Save most figures at 300 DPI instead of 150 DPI.
save_high_res.title: Save High Res

figure_format.description: Output figure extension used by the visualisation suite, commonly 'png', 'pdf', or 'svg'.
figure_format.title: Figure Format
